text:
maria: Quick pulse — prepping the catalog canary for next week. Need final owners for: license signoff, perf profile + canary infra.

devin: I can take perf profile and the quantization checklist. plan to run 24h perf job on staging Thurs.

ashok: @devin thx — do you need me to rerun evals with the new padding behavior? results changed last run.

devin: maybe. if you can re-run with seq=1024/512 splits that would help isolate tails. small script: `python eval_runner.py --seq 512,1024 --warmup 100`

katie: I'll own license signoff. Linked legal PR at https://git.internal/r/redwood/licenses/pulls/46 — waiting on one clarifying question about L3 model weights.

maria: @katie thanks. if legal says L3 restriction, we need a fallback variant on the model page and traffic routing policy. can you confirm by EOD?

katie: yes, pinging legal now. ETA EOD PST. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: infra-bot: scheduled canary pool allocation request created (req-8843). Need capacity confirmation from infra team.

infra-bot: infra-bot: req-8843 pending — estimated GPU allocation: 4xA10, ephemeral staging, 48h window. Approve to provision? (react with :thumbsup: to approve)

maria: If legal blocks L3, we'll still canary with a smaller variant (silverthorn-lite). @devin can the perf job run both variants in the same window?

devin: Yes — I planned parameterized runs. I'll tag results as `silverthorn-v2` and `silverthorn-lite-v2`. outputs go to `/runs/catalog/canary-4932/`.

ashok: re: evals, FYI last run showed a subtle regression on summarization QUIP metric when quantized q4_0. Might be config related. I'll re-run with `--kv-scrub true` and attach diffs.

katie: Legal replied: "L3 distribution is allowed under research-only clause but not redistributable." They suggested adding a visibility tag + usage note. I updated PR comment.

maria: Good catch. Action items: (1) @katie finalize license line + update model metadata (visibility=restricted) — EOD. (2) @devin run dual-variant perf jobs Thu and upload traces — Thu 18:00. (3) @ashok re-run evals with kv-scrub and seq splits — Thu morning. (4) infra team: please approve req-8843 provisioning.

samir: I'll follow up with infra owners and ping ops channel.

devin: one more — we need a routing fallback in the catalog config if silverthorn-v2 fails SLO. Suggested snippet for routing:
```
routing:
  primary: silverthorn-v2
  fallback: silverthorn-lite-v2
  slo: p95_latency_ms < 350
```

maria: perfect. I'll add that to the rollout doc. tagging owners in the rollout checklist now.

katie: legal also asked for a short usage blurb for the model page. I'll draft and push to the metadata file.

ashok: starting evals now, will post diffs to the thread when done.

maria: thanks — small follow-up: anyone blocking CR review for the catalog manifest changes?

devin: I've left one comment in the manifest PR about the shape migration; otherwise ready.

katie: LGTM on metadata PR from my side once I add the legal blurb.

samir: infra-bot: req-8843 approved by infra-ops. Provisioning scheduled for 2024-04-11T03:00Z.

maria: Awesome — we'll reconvene async tomorrow if any of the runs show issues. Posting a quick checklist to the catalog launch board. :rocket:

ashok: evals done — dropping results summary: small reg on QUIP (delta -0.8), otherwise stable. uploading diffs now.

devin: got the traces, starting analysis. If QUIP stays down after q4_0, we might try q5_0 or a calibration step.

maria: great work team. I'll mark this thread as the single source for canary coordination. add any late blockers here.

katie: added legal blurb to metadata and linked the PR.

maria: last ask — when runs finish, please add a one-line status comment to the rollout doc with links to traces and eval diffs. thanks all!
